title: Average sensitivity of polynomial threshold functions

result.label: Average sensitivity of polynomial threshold functions
result.statement: Proves that a degree-at-most- d polynomial threshold function on the uniform n -dimensional Boolean cube has average sensitivity at most 8d n, uniformly for 1 d n. Average sensitivity counts expected output changes under single-bit flips. This establishes the asymptotic Gotsman–Linial conjecture, allowing polynomial zeros with sign (0)=1.
